name: TechNVision Ventures Limited
summary: TechNVision Ventures Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides information technology products and services in India and internationally. It offers enterprise data management suite, which enables organizations to implement database archiving, test data management, and application retirement across various enterprise data; enterprise cash flow management solution, which automates cash flow processes; and enterprise talent management services, including sourcing, applicant tracking, and B2B exchange for staffing for hi-tech, engineering, medical, pharmaceutical, banking, and financial companies.
